title: Restore test
help: A backup only counts if it comes back. Each week, after that day's scheduled backup, restic checks the repository and reads back part of the stored data, then every website's newest restore point is read as a restore would read it: each database dump in full, which must end like a finished dump, and a spread of the home's files, which must match their recorded size. Nothing is written to the websites.
overdue: No restore test has passed since {when}.
neverPassed: No restore test has passed yet.
weekly: Test the restore points every week
settingsHelp: The test runs right after the scheduled backup on that day, so it never competes with it. Reading more data finds more damage but takes longer, and costs download fees on cloud storage.
needsSchedule: The daily backup is off, so the weekly test does not run. Turn the schedule on, or use Test now.
noRuns: No restore test has run yet.
repositoryCheck: Repository check, {percent}% of the data read back
